claims.text: The resort is one of two inland locations in The Red Sea Development Project on Saudi Arabia's west coast.

findings.quote: Six Senses Southern Dunes, The Red Sea is one of two inland locations that, together with coastal and marine initiatives, form The Red Sea Development Project
findings.note: The page names it as one of two inland locations in the project.

findings.quote: spans 10,800 square miles / 28,000 square kilometers on Saudi Arabia’s west coast
findings.note: The project is on Saudi Arabia's west coast.

claims.text: The resort is set among the Alnesai dunes.

findings.quote: pleasure-seekers who want to relax in the tranquility and serenity of the Alnesai dunes
findings.note: The page names the Alnesai dunes as the resort's setting.

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites surround the main Oasis complex, with pool villas dotted around the resort.

findings.note: Rooms and suites surround the Oasis complex, and pool villas are dotted around.

findings.quote: our guest rooms boast spectacular desert vistas and unique cultural charms

findings.quote: with interiors reflecting the tones and textures of the sandy dunes and soft furnishings drawing from the rich colors and patterns of traditional Bedouin tribal dress

claims.text: The resort is open all year round.

findings.note: The page states the resort is open year-round.

claims.text: The signature restaurant serves flavors from Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Syria, Persia and Lebanon.

findings.quote: Signature restaurant serving authentic flavors from across Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Syria, Persia, and Lebanon.
findings.note: Al Sarab is the signature restaurant, and all five countries are listed.

claims.text: Destination dining is offered at out-of-the-ordinary locations in and around the resort.

findings.quote: Destination dining offering unforgettable dining experiences at out-of-the-ordinary locations in and around the resort.

claims.text: The resort pays homage to Nabataean architectural heritage and its desert surroundings.

findings.note: Both the two floors and the self-shaded water surfaces are stated.

claims.text: Experiences range from immersing in village life to adventure activities in the desert.

findings.quote: From immersing in village life to adventure activities in the desert, explore the beauty of the region.
